svg.title: The pricing ladder: each field walks its rungs and the rung that answered is stored
svg.desc: A model's price fields walk a ladder: the provider's own model list first, then models.dev, then the optional LiteLLM map, then the cross-provider vote, and finally unpriced. Each field that a rung answers records that rung beside the number, so a request's cost carries its provenance. A request that no rung can price is stored as unpriced rather than guessed.

g.text: The same ten-rung resolver answers context, output limit, vision, tools and the four cache prices.
Where the routed deployment's own model list supplied a value, the badge reads provider /models
or models.dev; where the ladder supplied it, the rung is exact. The Models page and every
generated agent catalogue read the same resolver, so they cannot disagree about a number or its source.
A price a source states is used; a price no source states is shown as not priced with the reason.
Each request is priced once, as it is logged, and the rung that answered each price is stored beside the number.
Anthropic's 5-minute and 1-hour cache writes are recorded separately, and an hour write is priced only
at a rate a source states. A media request is priced the same way: provider figure, models.dev, LiteLLM
